headline: WNBA Finals Game 4: Dream chase first championship; Valkyries fight for Game 5
whyCareReason: Atlanta leads the series 2-1 and can clinch the WNBA title today. Golden State face elimination.
teaser: Saturday 24 October, State Farm Arena. Dream lead 2-1 after 97-71 blowout. Reese historic double-double run.
story: Game 4 of the WNBA Finals takes center stage on Saturday, 24 October, at State Farm Arena in Atlanta, with the Atlanta Dream on the cusp of the first championship in franchise history. Atlanta leads the series 2-1 following Wednesday's 97-71 blowout in Game 3, powered by Angel Reese's historic 21 points, 12 rebounds and three steals. Reese became the first player in WNBA history to record a double-double in each of her first three Finals games. Rhyne Howard and Naz Hillmon have provided balanced scoring and lockdown perimeter defense. The expansion Golden State Valkyries face elimination and must win on the road to send the series back to the Chase Center in San Francisco for Game 5.
stakes: Championship point for Atlanta. Golden State face elimination and need a road victory to keep their title dreams alive.
rivalryAngle: The expansion Valkyries face their first elimination game of the Finals in Atlanta.
funFacts: Atlanta leads the series 2-1 after winning Games 2 and 3 by double digits.
Game 4: Saturday 24 October, State Farm Arena. Series on the line.
Series history: Game 1 Valkyries 68-64; Game 2 Dream 79-65; Game 3 Dream 97-71.
